page_topic_one_liner: AI code review tools — PR diff analysis, security flags, and CI-integrated quality checks
differentiator_vs_generic: Pull-request diff panel with inline AI comment flags and security severity badges, NOT inline code completion or terminal CLI.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): PR diff view with green/red hunks, floating AI review comment pins on changed lines, and security shield badge with severity dot
CI pipeline strip: commit → scan → approve icons linked by torn-paper arrows (blurred labels only)
2x2 grid of review finding tiles (SQL injection flag, style nit, missing test, performance hint) — UI fragments only
Magnifying glass zooming on one inline AI comment bubble attached to a diff hunk

en.headline: BEST AI CODE REVIEW TOOLS
en.subtitle: Diff · Security · CI
en.composition: Visual-only collage for AI code review tools comparison: (1) HERO PR diff panel with AI comment pins and security badge on right two-thirds. No completion ghost-text hero, no terminal hero, no ranking text, no blank diff.
